subject: general
question: In which year was the Konkan Railway constructed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1998**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **1998** is the year when the Konkan Railway was constructed.
 
• The Konkan Railway is one of the most significant railway projects in India, connecting the western coast of India with the rest of the country.
 
• It covers the regions of Maharashtra, Goa, and Karnataka, providing a crucial link for transportation and trade.
 
• The construction of the Konkan Railway involved numerous engineering challenges, including the construction of numerous tunnels and bridges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Konkan Railway project was initiated to reduce the travel time between Mumbai and Mangalore.
 
• It is considered a marvel of modern engineering due to the difficult terrain and the extensive use of tunnels and viaducts.
 
• The railway line significantly boosted the economy of the Konkan region by improving connectivity and transportation of goods and passengers.
 
• The Konkan Railway Corporation Limited (KRCL) was established in 1990 to oversee the construction and operation of the railway line.
